title: Chapter 2 · Aitor held: player 2 plays her side
description: The first Queen at a tenth of her PV takes Aitor: his eyes go violet and, on her turn, his commands cross to her side of the fight for player 2 to play against Gerard, with the same control as his own turn: Atacar with its element, every skill of the ánima he wears (cures and boosts on himself, Dadista's dice, an awake definitiva), Defender, and L / R (Q / E) to change ánima, never onto Gerard's. Whatever he picks, the thread of gum makes it hurt. Played alone here, so the keyboard drives him.

steps.caption: At her tenth she has Aitor: «Suyo», his eyes violet
Her turn is his: his own commands cross to her side, for player 2 to play against Gerard
R (E on the keyboard): he puts on another ánima of his, free, the turn still his; its skills fill his list
One of his own skills, aimed at Gerard now; one he cannot pay for is greyed out, as on his own turn
Aitor's blow lands on Gerard: without the artilugio this only ends one way
